latest_review_repairs.cached_inline_images: Check the current malware policy first, then hydrate an encoded cached image before any DNS safety check; perform URL DNS safety only for an actual network fetch, including when auto-resolve is disabled.
latest_review_repairs.mounted_image_lifecycle: Keep the Compose-mounted image keyed to content and URL rather than the global media-resolution counter, preserving the original decoded handle and share bytes across unrelated rebuilds.
latest_review_repairs.malware_refresh: Publish an observable revision after replacing the malware list; mounted images are hidden until rechecked and each blocked image entry routes through the localized malware warning, including non-first URLs. A Robolectric Compose regression covers a blocked second image.
latest_review_repairs.timeline_miss_cache: Bound negative persisted-lookup memory by both 10,000 entries and an estimated 4 MiB while retaining cache writes as miss invalidations.
latest_review_repairs.url_apostrophes: Allow apostrophes within explicit, bare-domain and URI candidate spans while retaining the existing trailing-quote trimming policy.
latest_review_repairs.unsupported_uri_prefetch: Suppress embedded domains for known and unknown non-HTTP opaque URI schemes while retaining Link:/Visit: prose-label extraction; retain hierarchical-scheme suppression for all `scheme://` URIs.
latest_review_repairs.mounted_gif: Exercise the actual Compose AppMessageContent image mount with an injected deterministic safe-malware decision, while the separate mounted malware warning test verifies the real filter; retain the visible GIF and original share bytes through the mounted viewer's Share control across process memory trim. The real-filter adapter test now waits for persisted refresh completion after observing its policy revision, preventing its worker from writing after the test closes storage.
